reason: Verification failed due to critical gaps versus the specification (missing HealthEnvironment and dynamic PolicyMaker, metrics misalignment, parameter naming mismatches). With two iterations remaining, there is clear potential for significant improvement by implementing the core entities, aligning parameters and metrics, and integrating risk-policy feedback. The code runs and is stable, so focusing the next iteration on model completeness and spec compliance is feasible and necessary.

specific_areas: Add HealthEnvironment entity with risk_signal_series and current_prevalence; implement update_risk_signal(day) and integrate into individuals' update_risk_perception each day.

Replace static PolicyAuthority with dynamic PolicyMaker implementing enact_or_lift_mandate(adoption_recent), adjust_enforcement(recent_violations), and run_information_campaign(observed_risk). Wire mandate_active and enforcement into decision logic.

Align parameters to the spec with alias mapping: time_horizon_days, average_degree, risk_signal_series, location_mask_policy_rate, workplace_policy_rate, subsidy_amount, supply_capacity_per_day, activation_threshold, deactivation_threshold, adoption_threshold_target, media_channel_mix, message_valence_distribution, enforcement_effect_on_compliance. Preserve backward compatibility.

Extend Person to include missing attributes (political_orientation, workplace_type, location_preference, compliance_cost_sensitivity, habit_strength, fatigue_level, mask_quality) and behaviors (update_habit_and_fatigue, share_information). Use habit_formation_rate, fatigue_rate, forgetting_rate.
Instantiate MediaChannel objects from media_channel_mix and message_valence_distribution; implement amplify_or_counter_misinformation varying by channel credibility/type.
Implement location-level policy heterogeneity using location_mask_policy_rate and workplace_policy_rate; incorporate enforcement_effect_on_compliance in wearing probability.

Retail market minimal upgrade: support multiple retailers (num_retailers), implement adjust_price using price_elasticity_of_demand and simple rationing_policy; track total_units_demanded, total_units_supplied, and stockout_events count.

Compute full metrics with exact names: adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_target_adoption (0.7), sustained_adoption_days, adoption_by_subgroup (age, income quintiles, vulnerability, political_orientation), mandate_effect_uplift (paired counterfactual), information_campaign_effect, supply_fill_rate, stockout_events (count), enforcement_actions_count, inequality_in_adoption (Gini). Ensure JSON-safe values.
Performance and consistency: pre-index locations_by_type; update or remove Retailer.stockout_days; rename enforcement_events to enforcement_actions_count; use gini() for inequality.

task_understanding.adjustments: Adopt a strict spec-compliance checklist. Treat HealthEnvironment, dynamic PolicyMaker, parameter-name alignment, and full metrics set as mandatory for the next iteration.

data_analysis.adjustments: Prepare or synthesize a simple risk_signal_series for testing HealthEnvironment integration (e.g., a bell-shaped curve). Define subgroup bins for income quintiles and vulnerability to validate subgroup metrics.

model_planning.adjustments: Design clear interfaces: HealthEnvironment.update_risk_signal(day), Simulation._update_risk_perception(person, prevalence), PolicyMaker methods, and minimal share_information behavior. Define how mandate and enforcement modify wearing probability and purchases.

code_generation.adjustments: Refactor to introduce new entities while preserving backward compatibility. Implement alias mapping for parameters and ensure exact metric names. Add dataclass fields and docstrings for new attributes and behaviors. Keep deterministic RNG across baseline and counterfactual runs.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit-style checks: (1) metrics keys exist with exact names; (2) mandate toggles at thresholds; (3) risk perception increases with prevalence; (4) alias mapping works; (5) Gini computed and finite; (6) stockout_events increments correctly. Validate JSON-serializable outputs.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run baseline plus paired counterfactuals for mandate_effect_uplift and information_campaign_effect using identical seeds. Ensure locations_by_type pre-indexing is used to avoid repeated filtering.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_target_adoption at 0.7, sustained_adoption_days, subgroup metrics, supply_fill_rate, stockout_events count, enforcement_actions_count, and inequality_in_adoption (Gini). Validate lengths and ranges; ensure no NaNs or Infs.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report spec coverage explicitly, listing which required entities, parameters, and metrics are implemented and which remain. Highlight any deviations or approximations and their expected impact.
